note: Year-round camping in several named campgrounds on the State Fair grounds in Huron, the state's largest campground: Coyote Corner has full hookups; Pasque Park, Pheasant Park, Walleye Island, Rushmore Corner and Buffalo Trails water and electric; Gopher Run electric only. Outside the State Fair and Wheel Jam nothing is reserved - pay at the campground kiosks or the fair office (not more than a week ahead). Weekly $150 and monthly $600; rates may vary for special events. --Claude
